correctness.rationale: The explicitly labeled 12-vertex 24-edge Chvátal graph has Ind_2 defined by maximum induced vertex degree <=1. Enumerating all 4095 nonempty masks gives 424 faces (f-vector 12,66,148,142,52,4). Independent recomputation of the exact face-poset pivot matchings checked all nonempty cover directions and DAG topological sorts: for K there are 211 matched pairs and only a vertex and 3-cell critical, proving K≃S3 integrally; D0 has 302 faces and critical (0,3), L0 121 and only (0); D2 305 and only (0), L2 118 and critical (0,2). The source gives actual legal elementary collapse pairs for L0 and D2, stronger than homology vanishing. Full graph automorphism enumeration yields D4 and the A (4 vertices)/B (8 vertices) orbits, transferring the representative data. The inclusion Dv ->K is homotopy equivalence for A by coning contractible Lv; for B contractible Dv gives K≃ΣLv. Independent exact signed Lefschetz calculations for r,s on all 424 faces produced nonempty traces 2 and 0, hence top H3 traces -1 and +1, matching (-1)^a. The verified acyclic Morse matching, not mod2 homology alone, establishes the integral homotopy types.
residual_risks: Finite calculations support the structural proof; they are not a proof by sampling.
